title: A Harbor for the Uniform
author: Tamsin Reyes
blurb: Hazel Crane, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the century turns.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
